name: Paul Cézanne
findings: Within his own canvases, chocolate turns up as a small accent in 80% of the paintings that hold it, 2.4x the archive's rate (from 1336 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, marine blue turns up as the lightest note in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 4.2x the archive's rate (from 1336 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, fuzzy wuzzy turns up as the shadow in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 2.1x the archive's rate (from 1336 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1336 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1336 paintings here).
Pairs black bean with seal brown more than chance would predict (3 of 1336 paintings here).
Pairs pale cerulean with pastel blue more than chance would predict (3 of 1336 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (smoky black, black, dark jungle green) covers 62% of his paintings here.
